answer: Proof-of-useful-work identity: an ID is minted only after one fresh GPU job per epoch, seed unique so no proof replays across clones. How it runs: 1) post 5,000 USDC escrow; 2) a 90-second attested H100 slice is assigned; 3) verifiers re-run and match hash; 4) mint releases ID and returns stake. Attack math: 1,000 clones burn 1,000 x $4 = $4,000 of GPU time per epoch, and failed proofs forfeit half the escrow, so costs spiral instead of amortizing. Like proving a migration route with one sparrow over the tundra: each clone flies its own bird, and winter never discounts the fare.
